jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Engagement
jobs.jd_full:
What You Will Do

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of Lattice Engagement and help define what great employee listening looks like in the years ahead.

Employee listening is a critical way HR leaders understand their organizations, build trust with employees, and turn feedback into action. As expectations for listening evolve, Lattice has an opportunity to make Engagement a more strategic, intelligent, and indispensable part of how companies lead.

You’ll create the long-term strategy for Lattice Engagement and lead the first major iteration of that strategy from discovery through launch. You’ll join a cross-functional team ready to execute, and together you’ll build products that give HR leaders a clearer understanding of their people—and the confidence to act on what they learn.

If you enjoy solving meaningful customer problems, developing a strong point of view, and turning strategy into high-impact products, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for Engagement, you will:

  • Own the Engagement and employee-listening strategy. Define not only what we build next, but what the future of employee listening should mean for Lattice and the HR leaders we serve.
  • Turn insight into action. Develop product experiences that help HR leaders gather meaningful feedback, understand what it reveals, and take action that improves the employee experience.
  • Lead strategy. Drive discovery, prioritization, execution, launch, and iteration for the products that bring this vision to life.
  • Build a deep understanding of customers. Partner with Research to understand the needs, workflows, and most important decisions of HR leaders, and use those insights to guide the roadmap.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design. Translate customer problems and product strategy into clear, high-quality experiences that customers will want to use.
  • Use data to sharpen decisions. Work with Data Science to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continually improve the product.
  • Drive go-to-market readiness. Partner with Product Marketing to shape positioning, launches, and customer communication.
  • Own outcomes. Set and influence the key results that show Engagement is creating value for customers and for Lattice.

What You Will Bring to the Table

We’re looking for a product manager with the strategic instincts, customer empathy, and employee-listening expertise to shape the next generation of Lattice Engagement. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Direct experience with employee engagement, surveys, employee listening, feedback, research, or insight products.
  • A clear and informed point of view on the future of employee listening, including how product innovation can help organizations better understand and respond to their people.
  • A track record of taking ambiguous, high-impact product problems from strategy through execution and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Deep customer empathy and an ability to understand the priorities and challenges of HR leaders.
  • Strong product judgment: you can balance a compelling long-term vision with the practical decisions required to ship meaningful work now.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, especially with Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, and Product Marketing.
  • A bias for action and the ability to create clarity and momentum in an evolving space.

Bonus:

  • Experience building products for HR, people teams, or other complex organizational workflows.
  • Experience with AI-enabled research, feedback, analytics, or insight products.

If you have strong experience in employee listening, survey products, or adjacent customer-insight domains—even if you do not meet every preferred qualification—we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for a strong product thinker with a meaningful perspective on the future of employee listening, not a perfect resume.

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

___

The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Lattice offers eligible Canada-based employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; mental health and wellness support; emergency weather support; 16 weeks of paid parental leave; flexible time off, 13 company holidays, and 3 recharge days; a monthly remote-work stipend and one-time home-office setup stipend; an RRSP contribution match of up to 3% of gross pay (maximum $2,500 CAD annually); and a $500 CAD annual Learning & Development reimbursement. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements.

*Note on Pay Transparency:

Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience.

Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

About Lattice

Lattice is on a mission to build cultures where employees and their companies thrive. In an age where employees have more choices than ever before, businesses that put employees first are winning 🏅– and Lattice is building the tools to empower those people-centric companies.

Lattice is a people success platform that offers performance reviews, employee engagement surveys, real-time feedback, weekly check-ins, goal setting, and career planning in a way that allows companies to focus on employee development, growth, and engagement – yielding stronger employee retention, performance, and impact to the bottom line 📈. Since launching in 2016, we have grown to over 5,000+ customers globally, including brands like Loom, Robinhood, and Gusto.

Lattice is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Lattice is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

By clicking the "Submit Application" button below, you consent to Lattice processing your personal information for the purpose of assessing your candidacy for this position in accordance withLattice's Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Inventarios
jobs.jd_full:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, conquistando mentes y corazones.

Sobre este rol

En Cashea estamos construyendo el mejor marketplace de Venezuela y llevando la experiencia al siguiente nivel, tal como se merecen los venezolanos: una experiencia Premium.
El squad de Inventario mira toda la oferta. Queremos darles capacidades a los aliados para que escalen su negocio: que desde una misma tienda y con un mismo inventario vendan a todo el país, sin riesgos operativos. Conectamos el inventario de sus tiendas físicas con compradores de todo el territorio, para que vendan más sin subir sus costos de operación. Queremos ser su socio estratégico.

Como Senior Product Manager vas a ser responsable de la experiencia de venta online de los aliados. Tu pregunta de todos los días: cómo simplificamos la carga de inventario, la mantención de stock y precios, y qué capacidades les damos para que escalen y tomen mejores decisiones. Tu prioridad es hacer escalar el negocio de nuestros aliados.
Buscamos a alguien fuerte en estrategia y visión, que sea dueño completo del roadmap, que se ponga en los zapatos del aliado para entender sus fricciones y que piense en escala. Si te mueve construir el mejor marketplace de Venezuela desde la oferta, este es tu lugar.

Lo que vas a hacer

  • Visión estratégica y Roadmap: Liderar la visión y ser dueño de punta a punta del backlog y roadmap de la experiencia de venta del aliado, equilibrando impacto de negocio, valor para el usuario y viabilidad técnica.

  • Escala y simplicidad: Simplificar la carga de inventario, la mantención de stock y precios, eliminando fricciones para acelerar la operación de los aliados.

  • Sincronización con Comercial: Potenciar al equipo comercial integrando su voz e insights de mercado en la priorización, construyendo las capacidades estratégicas que aceleren la captación y el crecimiento de aliados en Marketplace.

  • Soluciones basadas en datos: Investigar de manera proactiva la adopción, uso y métricas de venta para identificar la causa raíz de las fricciones y convertirlas en herramientas que le permitan al aliado tomar mejores decisiones.

  • Eficiencia operativa: Rediseñar procesos para reducir el trabajo manual tanto del aliado como de Operaciones internas, buscando siempre eficiencias a escala.

  • Alineación y Liderazgo de Stakeholders: Liderar la alineación con Ingeniería, Data, Operaciones, Comercial y Marketing, balanceando la deuda técnica con las oportunidades de negocio y gestionando los rituales del equipo.

  • Lanzamiento e Impacto: Coordinar la ejecución y lanzamiento de iniciativas de punta a punta, garantizando el onboarding efectivo y la comunicación con los aliados.

¿Qué buscamos en vos?

  • 4+ años de experiencia como PM, liderando productos en entornos digitales de alto impacto.

  • Experiencia en productos B2B.

  • Experiencia pensando herramientas que ayuden a escalar el negocio de los clientes.

  • Experiencia en eficiencia y procesos.

  • Organización para manejar varios canales de comunicación y priorizar entre demandas distintas.

  • Capacidad de liderazgo y resolución, con el hábito de cuestionar la causa raíz de los problemas.

  • Visión de negocio y ambición para pensar en escala.

  • Empatía con los aliados: entender su operación y sus fricciones.

  • Perfil analítico: dominio de funnels, métricas de producto y frameworks de priorización.

  • Capacidad para alinear áreas y decir que no con datos.

  • Comunicación clara, síntesis y gestión de stakeholders.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

  • No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

  • Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

  • Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.

  • Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

  • Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

jobs.title: Principal Security Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Information Security team builds and operates the capabilities that protect our systems and data while enabling engineering teams to move quickly and responsibly. The team partners across Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Cloud Platform to reduce security risk, strengthen regulatory readiness, and make secure development easier to adopt at scale.

As the Principal Security Product Manager at Upstart, you will define the product vision and roadmap for critical security capabilities spanning AI-powered security, vulnerability management, security automation, and risk visibility. You’ll translate user, security, business, and regulatory needs into products that engineers choose to adopt and that deliver measurable improvements in security risk.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for critical security capabilities, prioritizing investments based on user needs, risk impact, business value, and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with security engineers and engineering teams to translate pain points into clear requirements, scope MVPs, sequence releases, and make thoughtful build, buy, and retire decisions.

  • Drive adoption of security products and workflows that fit naturally into how engineering teams work, using feedback, usage, accuracy, and risk-reduction metrics to measure success.

  • Shape a connected AI-powered security platform spanning capabilities such as security reviews, continuous testing, vulnerability remediation, risk scoring, and reporting.

  • Build regulatory and audit requirements into product design, including evidence, audit trails, metrics, and controls that support ongoing readiness.

  • Communicate product strategy, investment tradeoffs, adoption, and measurable security outcomes to Information Security leadership and senior stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus 7 years of product management experience, including at least 3 years owning security, risk, developer-facing, or platform products.

  • Experience owning complex technical products from product vision and roadmap development through requirements, launch, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to define technical requirements, scope MVPs, prioritize roadmaps, and make build-versus-buy decisions.

  • Experience with security domains such as vulnerability management, application security, cloud security, security automation, or remediation workflows.

  • Experience defining and measuring product success using adoption, usage, quality, risk, or other quantitative product metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI-powered products, AI-enabled developer tools, or products involving AI governance and model evaluation.

  • Experience with developer tools, security platforms, or internal platform products used by engineering teams.

  • Experience building products in banking, financial services, or another regulated environment, including support for regulatory examinations or audits.

  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOC 2, or PCI DSS.Familiarity with security tooling such as ArmorCode, Wiz, Semgrep, SIEM platforms, or similar technologies.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Core
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.jd_full:
About Us:

Zensurance is redefining commercial insurance for Canadian businesses.

As a leading InsurTech, we make getting the right coverage simple, fast, and accessible through a digital-first experience. Our platform combines advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver tailored insurance solutions that help businesses thrive.

Zensurance has been recognized for its rapid growth and industry impact:

✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 (2023, 2024, 2025)

✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 (2024, 2025)

✅ Top Insurance Employers (2022)

At Zensurance, we value ownership, collaboration, and innovation. Our team thrives on solving complex challenges, challenging the status quo, and making a real impact in an industry ready for change.

If you’re looking to build something meaningful in a fast-growing, customer-focused company, we’d love to hear from you!

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager, Growth to own the growth strategy and outcomes across our New Business customer journey, from acquisition through quote conversion and online purchase completion.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced Growth Product Manager who can operate independently from day one. You’ll use experimentation, customer research, product analytics, and strong UX judgment to uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and drive measurable growth.

You’ll work closely with Product, UX, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and senior leadership to turn insights into clear decisions and action. You’ll also own and prioritize the UX team roadmap.

Responsibilities:

Growth Strategy & Funnel Performance

  • Own the growth strategy, priorities, roadmap, and outcomes for the New Business funnel, aligned with broader business objectives.

  • Build and continuously evolve the experimentation roadmap, using evidence and business impact to decide what to test, optimize, or invest in.

  • Analyze performance across channels, segments, and journey stages, partnering with Marketing when acquisition quality impacts conversion.

  • Take ideas from hypothesis through validation and measurement, using the right mix of experimentation, research, prototyping, and product changes.

  • Drive execution and delivery with Engineering from solution design through launch, managing scope, trade-offs, dependencies, and execution risks.

  • Continuously measure outcomes after launch and use learnings to inform the next set of priorities.

Customer Discovery & Experience

  • Build a deep understanding of customers through quantitative and qualitative signals, including behavioral analysis, persona development, and segmentation.

  • Use multiple data sources, challenge initial assumptions, and test alternative explanations before drawing conclusions or making recommendations.

  • Own the New Business customer experience, partnering with UX to improve flows, usability, and conversion.

  • Stay current on modern B2C UX patterns and trends to inform product decisions and improve conversion.

Senior Product Leadership

  • Own the UX team roadmap, balancing needs and trade-offs across domains.

  • Independently drive strategic conversations and decisions with senior and executive leadership, presenting clear recommendations, trade-offs, and evidence-backed narratives.

  • Lead across a matrixed environment, aligning Product, UX, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • Communicate complex problems and insights clearly and concisely, adapting the narrative for executive, business, and technical audiences.

  • Work confidently with Engineering to understand system behaviour, technical constraints, dependencies, and feasibility when shaping product opportunities.

  • Use AI effectively across discovery, research, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and delivery to improve the speed and quality of product work.

  • Support fellow Product Managers with growth analytics, experimentation, and measurement when needed, sharing practical guidance.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, including 4+ years of direct Growth experience in B2C products.

  • Proven track record of driving measurable impact across acquisition, conversion, activation, experimentation, or transactional customer journeys.

  • Deep hands-on experience with product analytics and experimentation, and the ability to independently investigate data and evaluate outcomes.

  • Strong discovery capability across behavioral analysis, customer segmentation, persona development, and quantitative and qualitative customer research.

  • Strong critical thinking and product judgment, with the ability to challenge data, assumptions, and competing narratives to reach evidence-based decisions.

  • Strong UX and customer experience judgment, with the ability to identify friction, challenge solutions, and partner effectively with UX.

  • Proven ability to operate independently, influence without authority, and drive decisions across senior leaders and complex cross-functional teams.

  • Strong working understanding of product architecture and system behaviour, with the ability to discuss dependencies, feasibility, and trade-offs confidently with Engineering.

  • Strong AI proficiency, with hands-on experience applying AI across product workflows beyond basic productivity use.

  • Proven ability to communicate complex product and data narratives clearly and concisely, including independently presenting recommendations to senior leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with complex, multi-step transactional, checkout, quote, or application funnels.

  • Experience in a high-volume B2C environment such as insurance, fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming.

$104,000 - $145,000 a year

The salary range for this role is $104,000 to $145,000, not including the annual discretionary bonus and any additional performance-based incentives.

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees may also be eligible for performance-based case incentive awards.

Benefits & Perks at Zensurance:

At Zensurance, we know that when our people thrive, so does our business. That’s why we offer a flexible, people-first work environment designed to support your well-being, growth, and success.

💻 Work Your Way

• Remote-first setup for added flexibility

• Home office allowance to create a comfortable workspace

• Top-tier tech: “Office in a box” with all necessary tech equipment

• Half days before public holidays: Enjoy half days before long weekends

❤️ Your Health, Your Way

• Flexible health and dental plans for families, including mental health support

• Health & personal spending accounts to invest in wellness your way

• Parental leave top-up, because family comes first

🚀 Investing in Your Growth

• Education assistance reimbursement for courses, conferences, books, and memberships

• Opportunities to learn from industry experts and grow your career

🤝 Staying Connected

• Weekly Friday huddles to share updates and connect across teams

• Virtual & in-person team-building events to strengthen our culture

We’re building something special. Come be a part of it!

AI Tools and Your Interview:

We know AI is a valuable tool, and you’re welcome to use it to prepare for your interview. However, please don’t use AI assistants during the live interview itself. We want to have an authentic conversation with you, and using AI during the interview could affect our evaluation of your suitability for the role.

Just so you know, we use an AI scribe to help us take notes and review interviews, ensuring a fair and clear process.

Diversity & Inclusion:

Zensurance celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and provide accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need support, let us know, we’re here to help.

Thank You!

jobs.jd_full:

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: $75-100 per hour

Reactivate is seeking a Temp Technology Project Manager, for a six-month contract assignment. This role will be responsible for interacting with key stakeholders across the company and the technology team to grow and scale the company’s technology platform. This person will also work closely with Reactivate employees to improve engagement with various technology tools. The role involves collaborating with all departments to identify process inefficiencies and resolve them through software improvement projects.

We are looking for someone who is agile and adaptable , a team player , and has a strong sense of collaboration to thrive in a dynamic environment and drive impactful technology initiatives. This role combines strong business analysis, project management, critical thinking, and facilitation skills . The ideal candidate is not simply a meeting facilitator or project tracker. They are an active participant in discovery and solution design who can ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, identify gaps, connect ideas, and help stakeholders translate business needs into clear, actionable technology requirements.

A key component of this role is real-time, visual collaboration . The successful candidate should be comfortable working creatively with stakeholders during meetings to map processes, sketch workflows, organize requirements, visualize potential solutions, and iterate on ideas as conversations evolve. They should be able to adapt quickly when new information emerges rather than relying exclusively on pre-defined agendas or documentation created after the meeting.

Strong closed-loop communication is essential. This individual will ensure conversations consistently result in documented decisions, requirements, owners, dependencies, and next steps, and that open items are followed through to resolution.

Contract Details: This is a six-month opportunity with an hourly pay rate of $75-100, depending on experience and qualifications.

Responsibilities ⚙️

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to analyze business processes, identify pain points and opportunities, and recommend technology or process improvements
  • Lead collaborative requirements discovery, translating business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and actionable development work

  • Facilitate creative, real-time visual collaboration using process maps, workflows, wireframes, whiteboards, and other techniques to develop a shared understanding of problems and potential solutions

  • Coordinate testing, validation, user acceptance testing, and stakeholder feedback throughout development cycles
  • Support Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily Scrum discussions, and release planning
  • Create and maintain Jira stories, tasks, bugs, and enhancements, tracking work from discovery through development, testing, release, and validation
  • Facilitate stakeholder and project meetings focused on active problem-solving and decision-making, maintaining closed-loop communication by documenting decisions, action items, owners, target dates, and unresolved questions through completion
  • Provide team, senior and executive leadership with clear project status, risks, recommendations, and decision points, and use reporting and stakeholder feedback to evaluate outcomes and inform future initiatives
  • Create process and user documentation to support successful implementation and adoption of technology solutions

Requirements 🎓

  • Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
  • 3–4 years of experience in technology project management, business analysis, product delivery, or a similar technology-focused role

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and technology infrastructure
  • Experience with sprint planning, backlog grooming/refinement, and daily Scrum meetings
  • Proficiency in Jira for requirements, workflow, backlog, release, and roadmap management
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to identify gaps, dependencies, conflicting requirements, and downstream impacts

  • Strong facilitation, organizational, written communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively with incomplete or ambiguous requirements and think creatively and adapt in real time as new information emerges
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader business objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate proactively, follow through on commitments, and maintain closed-loop communication across stakeholders
  • Ability to be agile, adaptable, collaborative, and a strong team player in a fast-paced environment
  • Preferred: Experience developing requirements visually and iteratively with stakeholders using process maps, workflows, wireframes, user journeys, or similar techniques

Why Reactivate ⚡

To support our incredible team and their families beyond the workplace, Reactivate provides an outstanding benefits package effective day one of employment. In addition to medical benefits, 401(k) options, professional development opportunities and a competitive paid time off policy, we allow work flexibility to contribute to a valuable work-life balance.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Development

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
jobs.jd_full:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You’ll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You’ll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

  • Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
  • Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
  • Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
  • Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

  • Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
  • Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
  • Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
  • Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

  • A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
  • GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
  • A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

  • Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.
  • Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
  • Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
  • Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
  • Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
  • Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
  • Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
  • Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
  • You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
  • The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

  1. Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  2. Conversation with the AI Product Director
  3. Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives
  4. Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 calendar days of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Hybrid Working Model
  • School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)
  • Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees
  • Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursdays

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

#LI-AV1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗  Approachable: We’re friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations, Enterprise
jobs.jd_full:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what’s next. For more than a decade we’ve helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we’re scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role:

At Vercel, the Revenue Operations team plays a critical strategic role in our growth. We empower our GTM teams with the systems, strategy, and insights they need to be successful. By aligning people, processes, and technology across Marketing, Sales, and Field Engineering, we optimize the entire customer journey and build a scalable revenue engine that drives Vercel forward.

We’re seeking a Sales Operations Lead to function as the operating partner to our Majors and Verticals sales organization in the US. You’ll align directly to our sales leaders and their account executives, owning the strategy, programs, and operating cadences that make the segment successful— from territory design and sales plays to forecasting, quarterly business reviews, and pipeline inspection. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Development, Finance, and GTM Systems to sharpen our segment and vertical strategy, optimize the seller experience, and drive measurable revenue growth across our Majors motions.

This is a high-impact IC role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution. Much of the infrastructure is already in place— a homegrown forecasting platform, weekly pipeline plan reviews, strong data foundation— so your job is to run the business on top of it, close the gaps, and define how Vercel scales into new verticals and wins in large enterprise. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York City, with three days a week in the office.

What you will do:

  • Serve as the strategic and operational partner to Majors Sales Leadership— owning the segment’s operating rhythm and using pipeline, win/loss, deal velocity, and retention analysis to advise on where and how to grow the business
  • Run core operating cadences, including weekly pipeline plan reviews, forecast calls, and monthly and quarterly business reviews— defining the metrics the team manages to, driving forecast rigor and pipeline health in our forecasting platform and Salesforce, surfacing renewal risk and upside early, and holding the team accountable on follow-through
  • Own territory and account planning for the segment: build the thesis behind each book (vertical, regional, or play-aligned), run carves and account transitions, manage rules of engagement between teams, and partner with Finance and Sales Leadership on capacity modeling, target setting, and annual planning

  • Lead enablement and change management for new processes, operating changes, and planning rollouts affecting the Majors teams— and own the operational onboarding of new reps and leaders, from book assignment and tooling to how we run the business

About you:

  • Track record as a high-impact IC— either broad, hands-on ownership at a scaling startup or an explicit enterprise or majors focus at a larger company

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Databases
jobs.jd_full:
Staff Product Manager, Databases

Location: US - Remote

About Us

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

About the Product Management Team

At Rubrik, our Product Management team is at the forefront of defining the strategy and driving execution to strengthen our leading platform for cyber-resilience. We are dedicated to meeting the ever-changing data management and security needs of our customers and wear multiple hats throughout the different stages in the product lifecycle and set the vision for our growing family of products. As advocates for both our users and our business, Product Managers balance varied perspectives and empower their teams to do great work.

About the Role

When a bank or a hospital loses a critical database to ransomware or a bad change, nobody asks about backup schedules. They ask how fast it’s back and whether they can trust what came back. Your job is to make Rubrik the answer to both questions for Oracle.

You’ll join the Databases product team with Oracle as your first focus, and own it end to end, from strategy to the outcomes customers see. Oracle is one of the hardest workloads we protect. Our customers run their most important systems on it. You’ll also lead work that spans several databases, with the PMs who own them as partners.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Management, Databases. You’ll work with engineering teams in the US and India.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Oracle roadmap. Set how Rubrik protects and recovers Oracle across RAC, Exadata, Data Guard, on-premises and cloud. Weigh recovery speed against data loss and effort, and make the call.
  • Be the product voice with customers. Run deep dives with DBAs, present to executives when the stakes are high, and explain where Rubrik fits next to Oracle’s own tools and other vendors.
  • Turn escalations into product. When a restore matters, you’re on the call for product, alongside support, engineering and the customer’s DBAs and executives. Bring a plan, then fix the cause in the product.
  • Drive work across databases. Lead initiatives that span several databases, such as recovering whole applications in the right order and proving that backups restore, and help decide which databases we protect next.
  • Choose with evidence. Use customer conversations, usage and support data to make the business case for what to build and what to defer. Write requirements engineers trust, with your reasoning shown.
  • Launch and land. Give sales engineers the positioning and training they need, and join the field on large enterprise deals. Work with partners such as Oracle and Everpure, and track adoption after launch.

What Success Looks Like

  • In 3 months, you’ve met customers, sales engineers and support. You know where Oracle protection works well and where customers need more, and you’ve written your view of the roadmap.
  • In 6 months, you’re the go-to person for Oracle at Rubrik, and your roadmap shapes what engineering builds.
  • In 12 months, you’ve shipped improvements Oracle customers notice. You’re leading a cross-database initiative with engineering, and you’ve fixed the root cause of a problem customers kept raising.

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle backup and recovery. You can explain how RMAN backups, archived redo logs and point-in-time recovery work, and what Data Guard and RAC change. You’ve run Oracle in production, supported it or built products for it, and you can go deep on architecture with engineers.
  • Typically 8+ years of product management for technical enterprise products, or equivalent years as a DBA, solutions architect or sales engineer whose calls changed what a team built or bought. You don’t need a PM title, but tell us what you changed.
  • Comfort in front of customers at every level, from a room of DBAs to a CIO.
  • Clear, precise writing and speaking. You can turn a messy situation into a short doc that gets a decision.
  • A zero-to-one mindset. You’ll write the plan for work that doesn’t have one yet, and do what needs doing whatever your title says.
  • Fluency with AI tools in how you research and write.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Exadata, Oracle Database Appliance, or Oracle Database on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with other enterprise databases, such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL or Db2.
  • Background in data protection, disaster recovery or cyber resilience.
  • Experience working with customers in banking, insurance, healthcare or government.

You may not match every line. If you’ve owned recovery for another enterprise database or for storage, and you’ve worked with Oracle, apply and tell us how you’d learn the rest.

jobs.jd_full:
Program Manager

Are you looking for an exciting new career opportunity? CellCarta, a leading Contract Research Organization, has an exciting opportunity for a Program Manager to join our dynamic team. In this client-facing role, you will help drive the successful execution of scientific programs, build strong partnerships, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across the organization. Join us in advancing precision medicine and helping bring innovative therapies closer to patients. Apply today!

Position Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for managing ongoing client programs and ensuring that CellCarta delivers on time, within budget and in line with client expectations. As such, the Program Manager interacts with clients, Management, as well as Scientific and Operational teams to lead programs to completion, drive project progress and manage project financial health.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage client projects and programs (multiple ongoing projects for the same client) from initiation to closure
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within the budget and scope specified in contractual agreements
  • Manage changes in project scope, timelines and budget
  • Coordinate and engage internal resources for flawless project execution
  • Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders, serving as the primary client contact
  • Develop project/program plans, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring feasibility
  • Track progress against project plans and set review meetings/dates to ensure projects remain on target
  • Intervene to resolve issues and initiate appropriate corrective actions or interventions wherever gaps in projects or programs are identified
  • Report and escalate to senior leadership as needed

Qualifications

  • MSc in life sciences
  • At least 3-5 years of experience in a similar client-facing/project management role
  • Effective leadership, interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong knowledge of techniques for planning and managing projects/programs in terms of scope, schedule and budget
  • Excellent client management skills
  • Sufficient seniority and credibility to advise and engage project teams to deliver as per contractual obligations
  • Ability to find ways of solving or pre-empting problems
  • Strong proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Proficiency in French and English, both spoken and written; the incumbent will be required to interact with clients and colleagues outside Quebec, as well as read and draft documentation in English, as required by industry regulations

Work Arrangements

  • Full-time position (37.5 hours per week), Monday to Friday during regular daytime business hours, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring 1 day per week onsite
  • Location: 3650 St-Urbain Street, Montreal, QC, Canada, H2X 2P2

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive Group Insurance Plans
  • Telemedicine service and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • RRSP contribution with employer matching
  • Vacation and personal days
  • Partial parking reimbursement and discount on monthly STM pass
  • Employee Annual Incentive Plan (EAIP)
  • Volunteer Time-Off Program
  • Onsite gym
  • Career development opportunities

About CellCarta

CellCarta is a global CRO that provides muti-omic pharma laboratory services though a harmonized global footprint and integrated logistics, spanning translational research through late phase clinical trials. At CellCarta, science is not just a discipline, but also a shared purpose. We’re a global team of experts across eight facilities in five countries, united by a commitment to propel precision medicine and make a difference in the lives of patients around the world!

Joining CellCarta means working with a team of dedicated professionals who are focused on achieving our mission to solve the scientific and operational barriers that hold back complex clinical programs, while being supported by a collaborative environment where expertise, curiosity, and contributions truly matter.

Map out your future with us!
